title: OffsetBias: Leveraging Debiased Data for Tuning Evaluators

live_model.evidence: Sec. 5: 'we use OpenAI's GPT-4o-2024-05-13 and GPT-3.5-turbo-0125 as proprietary baselines'

prompt.location: Appendix B.1 (General Single-turn pairwise prompt, from LLMBar); Appendix C: 'we adopt the original prompt template of each model'
prompt.note: The exact template used for the GPT-4o baseline is not stated; B.1 is the paper's own pairwise format.

claim.location: Table 4, row GPT-4o-0513, column Total (EvalBiasBench: 80 pairs x 2 position swaps)

notes: Greedy decoding. Soft gap: which prompt template was applied to the proprietary baselines.

resolution.plan: Sec. 5.3 and Appendix C say each baseline used 'the original prompt template of each model', which is undefined for GPT-4o; the only pairwise template printed is B.1 (LLMBar-derived single-turn format), so the evaluation script in the repository is needed to confirm what GPT-4o received. Then run the 80 EvalBiasBench pairs in both response orders (160 calls) with gpt-4o-2024-05-13, greedy, and compute total accuracy; compare with 86.9 (Table 4).
resolution.approximation: If the repository does not settle the template, default to B.1 and flag the comparison as approximate.
